results.question: 最近30天销售额最高的5个商品是什么？
results.sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS total_sales FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed') AND o.order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '30' DAY) GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: 最近三个月退款率最高的商品有哪些？
results.sql: WITH recent_sales AS (SELECT oi.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_sold_quantity, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '3' MONTH) GROUP BY oi.product_id, p.product_name), recent_refunds AS (SELECT r.product_id, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS total_refund_amount, COUNT(*) AS refund_count FROM refunds AS r WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' AND r.refund_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '3' MONTH) GROUP BY r.product_id) SELECT rs.product_name, COALESCE(rr.total_refund_amount, 0) AS total_refund_amount, COALESCE(rr.refund_count, 0) AS refund_count, rs.total_sold_quantity, rs.total_sales_amount, ROUND(COALESCE(rr.total_refund_amount, 0) / NULLIF(rs.total_sales_amount, 0), 4) AS refund_rate FROM recent_sales AS rs LEFT JOIN recent_refunds AS rr ON rs.product_id = rr.product_id ORDER BY refund_rate DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: 过去六个月每月销售额趋势怎么样？
results.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(o.paid_amount) AS monthly_sales FROM orders AS o WHERE o.order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '6' MONTH) AND o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC LIMIT 200

results.question: 消费金额最高的10位客户是谁？

results.question: 哪些商品销量高但退款也高？
results.sql: WITH product_sales AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.category, p.brand, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity_sold, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed') GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.category, p.brand), product_refunds AS (SELECT p.product_id, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS total_refund_amount, COUNT(*) AS refund_count FROM products AS p JOIN refunds AS r ON p.product_id = r.product_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' GROUP BY p.product_id), product_metrics AS (SELECT ps.product_id, ps.product_name, ps.category, ps.brand, ps.total_quantity_sold, ps.total_sales_amount, COALESCE(pr.total_refund_amount, 0) AS total_refund_amount, COALESCE(pr.refund_count, 0) AS refund_count, CASE WHEN ps.total_sales_amount > 0 THEN COALESCE(pr.total_refund_amount, 0) / ps.total_sales_amount ELSE 0 END AS refund_rate FROM product_sales AS ps LEFT JOIN product_refunds AS pr ON ps.product_id = pr.product_id) SELECT product_name, category, brand, total_quantity_sold, total_sales_amount, total_refund_amount, refund_count, ROUND(refund_rate, 4) AS refund_rate FROM product_metrics WHERE total_quantity_sold > 0 AND total_refund_amount > 0 ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC, refund_rate DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: 最近一年每个季度销售额是多少？

results.question: 银卡用户最喜欢购买哪些品类？
results.sql: WITH silver_users_orders AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.user_id, oi.product_id, oi.quantity, oi.item_amount FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN users AS u ON o.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE u.user_level = '银卡' AND o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed')), category_sales AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(so.quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(so.item_amount) AS total_sales FROM silver_users_orders AS so INNER JOIN products AS p ON so.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category), ranked_categories AS (SELECT category, total_quantity, total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS rn FROM category_sales) SELECT category FROM ranked_categories WHERE rn <= 5 LIMIT 200

results.question: 七天无理由退款主要集中在哪些品类？
results.sql: WITH seven_day_refunds AS (SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) AS refund_count, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS total_refund_amount FROM refunds AS r JOIN products AS p ON r.product_id = p.product_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' AND r.refund_reason = '七天无理由' AND r.refund_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7' DAY GROUP BY p.category) SELECT category, refund_count, total_refund_amount FROM seven_day_refunds ORDER BY refund_count DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: 最近三个月订单数环比有什么变化？
results.sql: WITH monthly_orders AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '3' MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m')), ranked_months AS (SELECT month, order_count, LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_order_count FROM monthly_orders) SELECT month, order_count, ROUND(COALESCE((order_count - prev_order_count) / NULLIF(prev_order_count, 0), 0), 4) AS AS环比_change_rate FROM ranked_months ORDER BY month LIMIT 200

results.question: 不同用户等级的退款金额分别是多少？
results.sql: SELECT u.user_level, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS refund_amount FROM refunds AS r INNER JOIN order_items AS oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id INNER JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id INNER JOIN users AS u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' GROUP BY u.user_level LIMIT 200
